bibliographic.title: SHADOW PLAY
bibliographic.author: Cressida Tseng
bibliographic.description:
An exploration of the frustration of harboring fractured memories and the guilt of making decisions with devastating consequences. You play as someone whose past choices have turned the forest kingdom’s cruel princess into a crow monster.

Now, she wants revenge.

Discover the beliefs that led you here and the choices you must make to fix your mistakes… and change your fate.
